names.note: Name page 14534 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Михаил (Троицкий), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Михаила пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and of the ten «Троицкий» folders already in the corpus none is a Michael.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Михаила пресвитера и мч. Андрея (1938).»

attestations.note: The day's fifth entry, a joint line for two men, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 14534 «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*troitsk*` returns ten folders and no Michael among them, and a Cyrillic grep for «Троицкий» over every `saint.json` the same. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
